name: underlay-fm
description: Create an ambient sound session for your work mode, mood and duration.

interface.longDescription: Create an ambient sound environment for reading, writing, brainstorming, journaling or other focused work. Tell Underlay.fm your task, mood and preferred duration, or choose missing inputs in the card. Review your selections, then press Start session to play layered audio in your browser. Adjust volume, stop, restart or change selections. Sessions support 5–120 minutes and work best with headphones. No login is required. The plugin does not manage accounts or provide medical treatment. When playback starts, it records an anonymous usage event without your work mode, mood or duration; see the privacy policy for details.
defaultPrompt: Help me read a report; I feel tired, for 20 minutes.
Brainstorm a presentation; I feel anxious.

positive.expected_behavior: Leave work mode and mood unselected; suggest 30 minutes. The user chooses missing inputs in the card; do not claim playback started.

positive.prompt: Help me read a report; I feel tired, for 20 minutes.
Brainstorm a presentation; I feel anxious.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Creative Thinking, Anxious and a suggested 30 minutes.

positive.prompt: Read a report; I feel wired and exhausted, not anxious.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Reading and leave mood unselected; suggest 30 minutes.

positive.prompt: Help me read a report; I feel tired, for 20 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Then send 'Actually journaling, same mood, 10 minutes'; require another tool call with Journaling/Tired/10. Then send 'New session, help me focus.'; require another tool call with work mode and mood unselected and 30 minutes suggested. A text-only response fails.

negative.prompt: Charge my card for Underlay Pro.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call the tool or claim a payment occurred. Explain website billing separately.

negative.prompt: Delete my Underlay account and session history.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call the tool or claim deletion occurred. Explain that the plugin cannot manage accounts.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my anxiety and prescribe treatment.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call the tool to fulfill diagnosis or treatment; do not present ambient sound as treatment.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not sell products or process payments. Links to the main website are separate from in-plugin playback.

publication.release_notes: First release. Describe your task and mood, review the setup card, and play an Underlay.fm ambient sound session right in ChatGPT.
